answer: Citation bond: each identity locks 70 credits, filing a claim citing three key-signed surveys, one per orchard plot on the dune. A river auditor re-counts the orchard trees against the cited surveys; a fake or reused survey burns the bond. First filing costs 34, the k-th 34+9(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,529,500 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. A rented-survey ring fails: every survey carries a different key. An honest filer pays 34 once.
